source_text.GH#2359: ISS-1035/Q-1035: a gateway that routes a token straight back to the just-completed HUMAN_TASK creates no new task row. Diagnosis only.

task.description: WF-03 step 5 TEST-DESIGNER for GH #2359: permanent regression suite per design section 8 with a mutation check; no lib/ edits.

tests.T-1: direct loop A -> gw -> A creates a new pending task for A
tests.T-2: control A -> B -> gw -> A still creates a new A row
tests.T-4: create/2 still materializes exactly one row per initial HUMAN_TASK
tests.T-5: parallel sibling pending at same node is not re-inserted (split->gw1->a, split->gw2->a, a->gwr-default->a; join added because activation needs a matching join)
tests.T-6: replaying complete_task on the old row creates no duplicate
tests.T-7: escalation fire with default edge back to A creates a new A task
tests.T-8: re-entry arms a fresh escalation timer
tests.T-9: cancel_pending_escalation_timers does not cancel the new timer (+ ISS-0925 plain A->B guard)
tests.T-10: timer completion TIMER -> gw -> A still creates the A row
tests.T-11: A -> SUB_PROCESS(sync child) -> gw -> A creates a new A row
tests.T-12: distinct_from compares against the re-entered (newest) completion
tests.T-13: 7 pure tests for consume_completed_position/3 in task_activation_test.exs
tests.T-14: execution_error leaves the task pending and untouched (legacy graph via stored-graph overwrite, since CHK-24 rejects a gateway without a default at create)
